description: This Python source file provides configuration utilities for a Resident Directory Management System backend. It includes functions to parse database connection strings, environment variable setters for database DSNs, CORS origins, and a Settings dataclass that encapsulates all configuration parameters read from environment variables or files, ensuring flexible configuration across different deployment environments.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A frozen dataclass holding the application's configuration settings, including database DSN, JWT secret and algorithm, token expiration, CORS origins, and admin credentials. It provides a static method to instantiate from environment variables.

methods.name: str|None _build_dsn_from_postgres_env()
methods.description: Builds a DSN string from environment variables related to Postgres connection details.

methods.name: list[str] _parse_allow_origins_from_env()
methods.description: Parses CORS allowed origins from environment variables, supporting multiple configuration options.

methods.name: Settings.from_env
methods.description: Creates a Settings instance by reading relevant environment variables and files, with fallback mechanisms to ensure configuration is retrieved.
